name: CA Sales Holdings Limited
summary: CA Sales Holdings Limited is a key player in the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector, with extensive operations both within South Africa and across international markets. Its broad range of services includes warehousing, efficient in-store execution, robust transport and logistics, sales management, merchandising, and advanced technology and data solutions. Additionally, the company provides expertise in shopper marketing, brand strategy development, point-of-sale management, retail training, and specific debtor services. The diverse product categories it handles span food items, home and personal care products, consumer durables, snacks and confectionery, paper goods, various beverages, pet care essentials, alcoholic drinks, frozen foods, and tobacco products with their accessories. Geographically, CA Sales Holdings maintains a presence in Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Mauritius, Mozambique, Namibia, South Africa, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. Founded in 2011, the firm is headquartered in Centurion, South Africa.
